message: Root cause: real drag-to-sidebar crosses the grid first, causing transient reorder and isDirty=true; cross-note guard then blocked move with Apply/Undo message. Fix: block dirty moves only if the dirty state predates the drag or belongs to a different action; allow current clean drag to reset original order and move. Browser verification with stubbed move API: realistic drag through grid to Quick produced /move target_notebook=Quick, removed tile locally, and ended dirty=false. Full suite: 303 passed, 4 deselected.
